$comment: boardlab-core's layering, enforced by scripts/check-architecture.mjs at build and test time. Distributions have their own architecture.json for their modules, mapping imports of this package into these layers.

bare.$comment: the bare distribution: the core with no modules

core.$comment: Every core-owned layer knows backends only through contracts. Product and transport names are forbidden throughout; domain code takes configuration through options, while CLI/server startup owns environment configuration.
